recognize_zh: 周邊血紅血球小而蒼白、中央淡染區擴大，並有鉛筆狀細胞（pencil cells），血小板明顯增多；右上內視鏡圖可見食道蹼（esophageal web），合起來是缺鐵加 Plummer-Vinson 症候群。抹片本身無法看出 JAK2 骨髓增生性腫瘤，需分子檢測。
features: Hypochromic, microcytic red cells with enlarged central pallor
Anisopoikilocytosis with elongated pencil (cigar) cells and occasional target cells
Increased platelets scattered throughout the field
No leukocytes, nucleated red cells or teardrop cells in the field
Inset endoscopic image showing a thin mucosal web in the upper esophagus
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows hypochromic, microcytic red cells with anisopoikilocytosis, including pencil cells and occasional target cells, and a conspicuously increased number of platelets. No nucleated red cells, teardrop cells, or immature myeloid cells are seen in this field. The endoscopic inset shows a thin esophageal web. Findings are consistent with iron deficiency anemia with thrombocytosis and Plummer-Vinson syndrome; because thrombocytosis may persist after iron repletion, testing for JAK2 V617F, CALR, and MPL mutations is warranted, as the morphology cannot distinguish reactive thrombocytosis from an underlying myeloproliferative neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia trait shows microcytosis with more target cells and basophilic stippling, a normal or high RBC count and normal iron studies.
ET shows thrombocytosis with normochromic red cells, and the diagnosis rests on driver mutations and marrow megakaryocyte morphology.

ddx.dx: Polycythemia vera with iron deficiency (masked PV)
ddx.vs: Iron-deficient PV may show microcytosis with a normal hemoglobin and an elevated red cell count, and is confirmed by JAK2 mutation and low EPO.
Anemia of chronic disease is usually normocytic or mildly microcytic with fewer pencil cells, high ferritin and low TIBC.
